en: Black‑and‑white interior view of an elegant early 20th‑century café or ice‑cream parlor. The room has ornate stucco ceilings, chandeliers with floral glass shades, patterned wallpaper, and dark wooden counters and cabinets. The long front counter is covered with cakes and pastries; a woman in traditional dress works behind it. At the back and right, small round tables with bentwood chairs fill the room, and display cabinets hold dishes and goods. A single customer sits at a table on the right. A hanging sign near a column reads "EIS-CAFE."
